title: Community Nutrition Initiative Evaluator
description: Students assess five community nutrition initiatives against a rubric of reach, sustainability, and cultural fit, then compare their scores to a reasoned model evaluation.
creator: Health Education
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Health Education

learningObjectives: Students assess five community nutrition initiatives against a rubric of reach, sustainability, and cultural fit, then compare their scores to a reasoned model evaluation.

pedagogical.instructionalRationale: Supports an Evaluate-level objective by having students rate program models against an explicit rubric and reconcile their judgment with a reasoned model evaluation.
